evidence: Labeled 'Mining' and modifies `src/node/miner.cpp`, `src/interfaces/mining.h`, and `src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp` to add `TxCollection` for block template assembly and validation.
rationale: Adds the `TxCollection` interface to validate miner-selected block templates without external mirror mempools, directly improving the interface external Stratum v2 services build on. The description explains this removes the need for independent mirror mempools that duplicate accounting and IPC bandwidth, enabling the Stratum v2 reference implementation flow in sv2-apps#599.
